title: The Gear Class

reward.description: A heavy cog of blackened steel, stamped with the Foundry's seal. It's oddly warm.

hints: Store teeth and material on self in __init__, after checking teeth is at least 6.
__repr__ must return a string. f"Gear({self.teeth}, {self.material!r})" puts quotes around the material.
__eq__ and __lt__ get another Gear as `other`. Compare self.teeth with other.teeth.
